existing_dsm_reference.ground_use: REJECTED: DSM includes buildings and vegetation, nominal 30m is insufficient for street steps/curbs.

adaptation_needed_before_runtime_change.work: Validate small bare-earth raster, horizontal transform, vertical datum and a stable ground reference. Set local ground_y=source_ground_height-reference_height; retain both measured height and relative building height separately.
Build terrain separately from roads/sidewalk breaklines, level building bases/courtyards and stairs/bridges/tunnels. A 5m grid cannot by itself resolve curbs or multi-level pedestrian structures.

Move exterior visual/collider pairs with their verified ground base while preserving source XZ and relative building heights. Adapt entrances, return points, source roof deck elevation and attached facades/labels consistently; avoid adding source building height twice.

Adapt Y=0 support planes, movement/spawn/fall boundaries, NPC/traffic route support, curbs and authored museum rise. Keep existing horizontal boundaries/source geometry and old W03 evidence intact; do not claim its flat-ground tests validate a new terrain.

Measure support continuity, capsule/head clearance, camera contact, doorway transitions and NPC/vehicle grounding, then repeat affected actual walking and lift/roof regressions on the same integrated scene.

minimum_decisive_experiment.precondition: Licensed local vector source controls are now available. Inspect their unknown vertical reference, interpolate with held-out source-spot checks and retain all interpolation uncertainty before adapting any runtime support.
minimum_decisive_experiment.candidate_extent: A roughly 250m local slice containing a known hillside approach and a level plaza/entrance; 5-10 open-ground reference samples, a walking profile, one doorway and one physical NPC.
minimum_decisive_experiment.comparison: Keep the current flat scene baseline; compare sampled terrain profile and physical walk over the same source XZ route. Record source uncertainty separately from engine support/capsule errors.
engine_checks: No unsupported gaps, stuck capsules or fall recovery during an actual walk.
Visual and physical support agree, doorway/return points remain clear.
Buildings keep their relative height and vertical walls; roof deck/lift remains aligned with the new ground base.
NPC remains physically supported across the profile.
minimum_decisive_experiment.decision_rule: Only expand after the slice establishes source fidelity and physical continuity. Numerical terrain accuracy tolerances must follow the acquired DEM metadata and independent reference quality, not invented metre-level claims.

unresolved: Vertical datum and independent source survey accuracy remain unknown.
A terrain grid, curbs/roads/building bases and layered bridge/tunnel surfaces have not been generated or integrated by this research.
The original official contours and spot heights are sparse controls; original 5m measured raster was not acquired.
Current manually authored museum rise and all Y=0 physics have not been validated against the new ground source.
initial_decision_before_anonymous_altern: Public 5m NGII DEM is a plausible bare-earth source, but this session acquired no exact terrain raster or exact ground anchors.

The official DEM catalogue is free and lists unrestricted reuse; file download requires NGII login and may require its transfer software. Do not equate anonymous catalogue visibility with anonymous raster availability.
NEINS public height analysis returned a height class only. Its value=0 is not ground elevation zero; do not use it as terrain or an anchor.
Keep the current local Y=0 explicitly temporary until licensed exact data and its vertical datum are inspected. Do not substitute the existing Copernicus DSM.
decision: The official Seoul data portal anonymously provided licensed 2023-source contour and spot-height vectors. These are the preferred new ground-shape controls for the project, with original heights and unknown vertical datum retained.
Exact region plus a maximum 200m metric interpolation halo is preserved in local EPSG32652/origin XZ JSON and WGS84 GeoJSON. The city archive remains temporary only.

No 5m raster was downloaded or generated: 5m contour spacing does not imply 5m measured terrain grid. Runtime interpolation, layered road/entrance/roof adaptation and physical verification remain separate work.

Mapzen AWS Terrain Tiles were anonymously acquired as an alternative, but SRTM surface bias and coarse/old coverage prevent treating them as measured city ground. NASADEM and FABDEM also have the access or reuse limitations recorded below.

mapzen_aws_srtm.SRTM_epoch: February 2000 original radar acquisition; later processing/void fills do not imply current-city survey

nasadem.limit: Not a new bare-earth Seoul survey; guide discusses phase-center vegetation bias.
